narrative.overview:
EDAForge pairs warm, modular Bento architecture with uncompromising statistical precision. Rather than dressing a local analytical workbench in purple-neon AI-startup tropes or flattening it into an austere spreadsheet, the interface frames work inside an atmospheric outer mat (#DCE8EB mineral mist in Light mode; #0D0B0F warm obsidian in Dark mode) with a floating vertical pill dock and a generous rounded stage window (28px radius).

Inside the stage, primary telemetry, data-health gauges, join previews, and confirmation counts occupy matte, color-drenched Bento tiles—Deep Petrol, Sage Mint, Blush Terracotta, Sunlit Sand, and Periwinkle Sky in Light mode, morphing into Deep Petrol-Teal, high-contrast Alabaster, and Electric Sky-Cyan in Dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: Floating slim icon pill dock (74px default, 24px radius, expandable to 234px) plus detached bottom squircle control pod (22px radius), separated cleanly from a rounded stage window (28px radius).
Color-committed matte Bento tiles grouped by spatial gap (14px–18px) rather than nested borders or side stripes.
Expressive geometric display numerals (Bricolage Grotesque) paired with neutral UI prose (Public Sans) and true code/ledger monospace (Azeret Mono).
Purposeful, reduced-motion-safe choreography: scroll-vernier progress rail, spring layoutId pills, child-surface hover lift, and interactive Sankey/paradox specimens.

rules.name: The Full-Surface Commitment Rule
rules.body: Color belongs to whole Bento tiles or genuine semantic badges (Grade A–E, warning, critical), never to 1-sided card stripes (border-left) or gradient text.

rules.name: The Dual-World Contrast Rule
rules.body: In Dark mode, exactly 1 focal telemetry tile may invert to crisp Alabaster (#ECF1F3 with #11181C ink) to anchor visual hierarchy without washing out neighboring dark charts.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never place an uppercase tracked kicker or eyebrow label above a heading; headings carry their own hierarchy, with supporting context placed below.

rules.name: The 12px Ledger Floor Rule
rules.body: No statistical count, sample size, or column type may render below 12px, and monospace classes never compound em scaling inside small footers.

rules.name: The Stationary Hit-Target Rule
rules.body: Interactive Bento cards keep their outer hit container motionless on hover while lifting .bento-inner by -2px (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), preventing pointer-edge flicker.

dos: Do group KPI metrics into color-committed matte Bento tiles (20px radius) with Bricolage Grotesque tabular-nums counters.
Do keep every page element and compact chart at opacity: 1 by default, using scroll progress to drive continuous data curves, ribbon flows, and header compaction.
Do sync tabs and triage filters to URL search params with { replace: true } so browser back-navigation preserves analyst context.
Do provide full prefers-reduced-motion alternatives and verify >= 4.5:1 contrast across both Light and Dark Bento worlds.
donts: Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrow labels above headings (FEATURES, PIPELINE, OVERVIEW).
Don't use purple-to-blue gradients, bg-clip-text gradient headlines, neon drop-shadows, or frosted glass cards over blurred blobs.
Don't put 1-sided colored borders (border-left: 4px) on cards or nest bordered cards inside bordered cards.
Don't use emojis as UI icons or allow Azeret Mono metadata to shrink below 12px.
